name: Virginia Vinegar Works
old_description: This rare vinegar is dark red and heavy bodied with a rich nose. It goes well with bold, mixed greens and blue cheese. Particularly good in a meat marinade or to add structure in marinara sauces and stews
about:
Virginia Vinegar Works is based in Shipman, Virginia, and has been producing artisanal vinegars since 2008. The operation began with wine vinegar made in porcelain crocks and has since expanded to stainless steel tanks and oak barrels for aging.

The company crafts wine vinegars, seasonal fruit vinegars, and malt vinegars using the traditional Orleans method, a slow conversion process that preserves the character of the base wine. Production involves stainless steel tanks for fermentation and older wine barrels for aging, after which barrels are selected for blends or single-varietal bottlings. Fruit vinegars combine rich wine vinegar with fresh fruit from nearby farms, while malt vinegars are made from local craft beer, yielding a robust, umami-rich product. The lineup includes varietal-specific vinegars such as Cabernet Franc, Chardonnay, Petit Verdot, and Albariño, as well as blended heritage red and white wine vinegars, white balsamic, sherry vinegar, and malt vinegar.

Virginia Vinegar Works serves professional chefs, restaurants, gourmet food outlets, and home cooks seeking exceptional flavor. Its products are marketed for both culinary and gift use, with direct shipping to customers. The company also offers consultation services.

The business was born from a desire to add exceptional flavor to the great local produce and meats available in central Virginia. The founders emphasize that the slow Orleans method and barrel aging retain the original character of the wine, creating vinegars with richness and depth that rapid commercial processes cannot achieve.
